Dallas County Goverment Officials
Directions on Google Maps.
Commissioners - County road concerns & county budget.
Clerk - Pam Louderbaugh - voter registration questions, election questions 345-2632
Collector - Sheryl Ferrell - county taxes. Personal & real estate. Merchant licenses 345-7836
Treasurer - Becky Schofield - manages county funds 345-2020
Circuit Clerk - Susan Potter - maintain files for circuit court 345-2243
Recorder - Stacy Satterfield - 108 S. Maple, Buffalo - maintain public records for county 345-2242
Circuit Court Judge - Judge Michael Hendrickson - resolution of litigants issues 345-1582
Circuit Court Associate/ Probate Division - Judge Lisa Henderson - handles traffic, civil, misdemeanors, decedents & guardian-ship estates 345-7641
Public Administrator - Carol Johnson - court appointed guardian of incompetent individuals 345-5899
Assessor - Sue Doty - provides information on ownership of property & determines market value of property for tax purposes 345-8774
Coroner - Lamont Swanson 417-770-0113
Prosecuting Attorney - Barbara Viets
Roads & Bridges - Sherry Maggard 345-6175
Dallas County Library - Nancy Bradley 345-2647
Health Center - Cheryl Eversole 345-2332
County Surveyor - Greg Maynard 345-7623
E-911 Director - Joseph Bright 345-1999
